templates.label: Reinforced Bulkhead Array
templates.slotUse: one hull module slot across one ship zone
templates.activation: Passive after installation.
effects: Grant one ship zone +2 armor AC and 20 additional structural hit points.
Grant one ship zone hardness +2 and +4 on checks to resist hull breach.
Reduce collision and ramming damage suffered by the installed zone by 25 percent.
templates.maintenance: Inspect welds, braces, and anchor points after every collision or twenty structural damage.
templates.restrictions: Adds significant mass; vessels below cutter size may require a propulsion recalibration.

templates.label: Storm Baffle Grid
templates.slotUse: one exterior ship module slot
templates.activation: Swift command from the helm; operates continuously while powered.
effects: Grant +4 circumstance on vessel control checks against severe wind, turbulence, and storm shear.
Reduce structural damage from ordinary lightning and hail by 50 percent.
Allow the vessel to ignore the first 10 feet of forced movement from wind each round.
templates.maintenance: Inspect vanes, grounding straps, and windroot seals after every major storm.
templates.restrictions: Reduces maximum speed by 5 percent while fully deployed.

templates.label: Lift-Fin Control Array
templates.slotUse: one propulsion or control module slot
templates.activation: Passive; helmsman may engage precision mode as a move action.
effects: Grant +2 competence on vessel control checks and increase tactical turn rate by one category.
Increase maximum speed by 10 percent in open sky.
Precision mode grants +4 on one docking, hovering, or obstacle-avoidance check but reduces speed by half for that round.
templates.maintenance: Balance fins and lubricate pivots after every ten voyages.
templates.restrictions: A vessel may benefit from only one primary lift-fin control array.

templates.label: Repair Drone Bay
templates.slotUse: one engineering bay and one module slot
templates.activation: Standard command from engineering; two deployments per day.
effects: Deploy drones to restore 4d6 structural hit points to one accessible ship zone over 5 rounds.
Deploy drones to suppress one fire, leak, jam, or disabled routine subsystem after a DC 20 Craft check.
Grant every qualified repair team aboard +2 circumstance on Craft checks for 10 minutes.
templates.maintenance: Replace drone parts equal to 100 gp after each deployment that repairs structural damage.
templates.restrictions: Cannot reach sealed, destroyed, or externally inaccessible zones without a route.

templates.label: Cargo Stabilization Rack
templates.slotUse: one cargo module slot
templates.activation: Passive after cargo is secured; loading requires 10 extra minutes.
effects: Grant +4 circumstance on checks to prevent cargo shift, breakage, or loss during turbulence.
Increase safe cargo capacity by 10 percent through efficient bracing and modular storage.
Reduce loading and unloading time by 25 percent when operated by a trained crew.
templates.maintenance: Inspect clamps, nets, and shock absorbers after every severe maneuver.
templates.restrictions: Only secured cargo inside the fitted hold receives the benefit.

templates.label: Cistern Purification Array
templates.slotUse: one life-support or cargo module slot
templates.activation: Processes stored water continuously while powered.
effects: Purify up to 250 gallons of ordinary contaminated water per day.
Grant +4 circumstance on checks or saves made to detect or resist contamination originating in the fitted cistern.
Condense up to 25 gallons of water per day from humid air or cloud passage.
templates.maintenance: Replace filters and catalyst salts after every 1,000 gallons.
templates.restrictions: Does not remove magical curses, concentrated brine, or contamination from outside the fitted system.

templates.label: Navigation Observatory
templates.slotUse: one upper-deck or command module slot
templates.activation: Requires 10 minutes of observation before granting route benefits.
effects: Grant +2 competence on Knowledge (geography), Survival, and Profession (navigator) checks made aboard the vessel.
Reduce ordinary route-error distance by 50 percent and reveal major drift changes after one hour of observation.
Once per day reroll one failed navigation or weather-prediction check made aboard the vessel.
templates.maintenance: Recalibrate lenses, charts, and celestial references after major island drift or magical interference.
templates.restrictions: Requires a clear observation port or external sensor mast.

templates.label: Signal Relay Mast
templates.slotUse: one exterior mast or communication module slot
templates.testSkill: Profession (signal officer) or Use Magic Device
templates.activation: Standard action to establish or change a channel.
effects: Double the range of compatible communication sets and tracker beacons aboard the vessel.
Transmit coded pulses up to 50 miles in clear open sky; decoding without the key requires Decipher Script DC 25.
Grant +4 circumstance on checks to detect, identify, or triangulate active signals within 20 miles.
templates.maintenance: Retune crystals and inspect the mast after storms or impacts.
templates.restrictions: Dense terrain, deliberate jamming, and planar boundaries block or reduce range.

templates.label: Crew Infirmary Module
templates.slotUse: one internal support module slot
templates.activation: Passive facility; emergency systems activate as a standard action.
effects: Grant +2 circumstance on Heal checks made in the infirmary and allow long-term care for twice the normal number of patients.
Patients resting for 8 hours recover one additional hit point per character level.
Once per day stabilize every dying creature in the infirmary after a DC 15 Heal check by the attending medic.
templates.maintenance: Restock medicines, sterilize surfaces, and inspect restraints after every voyage.
templates.restrictions: Healing benefits require a trained attendant and uninterrupted access to the facility.

templates.label: Crew Morale Quarters
templates.slotUse: one internal habitation module slot
templates.activation: Passive while occupied and maintained.
effects: Crew resting here gain +2 circumstance on saves against fatigue caused by routine long-distance travel.
Reduce morale penalties from cramped quarters or ordinary voyage length by one step.
Provide secure bunks, lockers, and emergency restraints for twenty Medium creatures.
templates.maintenance: Clean, ventilate, and inspect emergency restraints weekly.
templates.restrictions: Does not remove penalties from starvation, unpaid wages, disease, terror, or active mutiny.

templates.label: Boarding Winch Array
templates.slotUse: one exterior deck module slot
templates.activation: Standard action to launch; move action each round to reel or pay out.
effects: Launch reinforced lines up to 200 feet and grant +4 circumstance on boarding, towing, and emergency recovery checks.
Pull a secured object or creature with up to 5,000 pounds of load at 20 feet per round.
Hold two vessels within 100 feet of one another unless the opposed vessel succeeds on a control check against DC 20.
templates.maintenance: Inspect cables, hooks, and brake drums after every boarding action.
templates.restrictions: A severed or overloaded line may recoil dangerously across the deck.

templates.label: Emergency Lift Bladder
templates.slotUse: one exterior emergency module slot
templates.activation: Immediate command after catastrophic lift loss; one activation before replacement.
effects: Reduce a disabled vessel's descent to 60 feet per round for 10 rounds.
Grant +4 circumstance on emergency landing or evacuation checks after core failure.
Keep one ship zone buoyant long enough for crew rescue even if separated from the main hull.
templates.maintenance: Replace the bladder and inflation charge after deployment.
templates.restrictions: Cannot restore maneuverability or prevent descent indefinitely.

templates.label: Core Regulator Manifold
templates.slotUse: one engineering module slot adjacent to the core
templates.activation: Passive; emergency bypass is an immediate command once per day.
effects: Grant +2 competence on checks to control, stabilize, repair, or safely shut down the connected core.
Reduce fuel or charge consumption by 10 percent during ordinary travel.
Once per day ignore one core-instability result for 1 round, allowing a controlled shutdown or emergency maneuver.
templates.maintenance: Calibrate against the core after every major repair, overload, or replacement component.
templates.restrictions: Must be designed for a specific core family; adapting it is a separate improvement project.

templates.label: Stabilized Ballista Hardpoint
templates.slotUse: one deck weapon hardpoint
templates.activation: Crew-served weapon mount.
effects: Grant +1 competence on attack rolls with the mounted ballista or harpoon thrower.
Reduce penalties for firing during vessel movement or turbulence by 2.
Allow the mount to traverse and fire into one additional adjacent firing arc.
templates.maintenance: Inspect recoil braces and traverse gears after every ten shots.
templates.restrictions: Does not include the weapon or ammunition unless separately constructed.

templates.label: Arc Discharge Battery
templates.slotUse: one weapon module slot and core conduit
templates.activation: Full-round crew action; recharge 1d4 rounds.
effects: Fire a 200-foot line dealing 6d6 electricity damage; Reflex DC 18 halves.
Make a ranged touch attack out to 300 feet dealing 8d6 electricity damage to one target.
Discharge against an adjacent boarding vessel or Huge creature for 5d6 electricity damage and force a Fortitude DC 18 save or stun mechanical systems for 1 round.
templates.maintenance: Inspect capacitors and grounding straps after every three shots.
templates.restrictions: On a natural 1, the weapon is disabled until a DC 20 Craft repair is completed.

templates.label: Alchemical Broadside Projector
templates.slotUse: one weapon module slot and ammunition magazine
templates.activation: Full-round crew action; consumes one alchemical shell.
effects: Project a 60-foot cone dealing 6d6 fire or acid damage; Reflex DC 18 halves.
Coat a 30-foot-radius area within 200 feet in obscuring smoke for 10 rounds.
Create a 20-foot-radius adhesive field within 150 feet; creatures and exposed mechanisms pass Reflex DC 18 or become entangled until freed.
templates.maintenance: Flush projectors and inspect magazine seals after every shot.
templates.restrictions: Ammunition is expensive, volatile, and restricted in many ports.

templates.label: Ship Ward Projector
templates.slotUse: one defense module slot and core conduit
templates.activation: Standard command; three activations per day lasting 5 rounds.
effects: Grant one ship zone +4 deflection AC against ranged attacks.
Grant one ship zone energy resistance 20 against one selected energy type.
Create a 20-foot protective envelope granting crew +4 resistance on saves against wind, magical weather, and forced movement.
templates.maintenance: Inspect ward lattice and replace burned silver channels after each depleted activation.
templates.restrictions: Only one ward mode may operate at a time.

templates.label: Countermeasure Chaff Launcher
templates.slotUse: one exterior defense hardpoint
templates.activation: Immediate command; three salvos before reloading.
effects: Grant +4 dodge AC against one incoming ranged or guided attack.
Create a 30-foot cloud around the vessel for 1 round, granting concealment against attacks from beyond the cloud.
Force one tracking, scrying, or signal-lock attempt against the vessel to reroll and take the worse result.
templates.maintenance: Reload cartridges and clear launch tubes after use.
templates.restrictions: The cloud also imposes -2 on the vessel's own ranged attacks for the round.

templates.label: Stone-Heart Lift Core
templates.slotUse: one major core bay
templates.primarySkill: Craft (stonemasonry), Craft (shipwright), and Knowledge (architecture and engineering)
templates.activation: Continuous lift system requiring a trained engineer and daily inspection.
effects: Provide stable lift for a vessel up to the designed tonnage and grant +4 competence on checks against sudden altitude loss.
Grant the vessel +4 on saves or control checks against forced movement and ramming.
Continue producing half lift for 10 rounds after primary power failure, allowing emergency action.
templates.maintenance: Inspect rune channels and structural cradle daily; complete a full calibration every thirty days.
templates.restrictions: Heavy and slow to respond; maximum vessel speed is reduced by 10 percent unless separately improved.

templates.label: Windroot Living Core
templates.slotUse: one living core bay and environmental support chamber
templates.activation: Continuous living lift system requiring water, light, and regular tending.
effects: Provide lift for a vessel up to the designed tonnage and increase maximum speed by 15 percent in natural wind.
Grant +2 competence on control checks and allow the vessel to hover without fuel in ordinary open air.
Once per day regenerate 2d6 structural hit points in the core chamber after one hour of rest and care.
templates.maintenance: Water, prune, sing or resonate with, and inspect living seals every day.
templates.restrictions: Fire damage to the core is increased by 50 percent and severe neglect can make the core sick or unresponsive.

templates.label: Ember Pressure Core
templates.slotUse: one armored core bay with venting
templates.activation: Continuous powered lift system consuming refined fuel.
effects: Provide lift for a vessel up to the designed tonnage and grant +20 percent speed for up to 5 rounds of overdrive once per hour.
Supply one ship weapon with +1 damage per die while overdrive is active.
Ignore the first cold-based engine penalty each encounter through sustained core heat.
templates.maintenance: Vent heat after overdrive, clean fuel channels daily, and replace insulation after any critical core hit.
templates.restrictions: Overdrive requires a DC 20 engineering check; failure by 5 or more causes 4d6 fire damage in the core zone.

templates.label: Gyro-Aether Core
templates.slotUse: one precision core bay with stabilization ring
templates.activation: Continuous calibrated lift system requiring synchronized gyros.
effects: Provide lift for a vessel up to the designed tonnage and grant +4 competence on docking, hovering, and precision-maneuver checks.
Allow one immediate 10-foot lateral shift each encounter after a successful DC 20 control check.
Reduce penalties from unstable load distribution or damaged control surfaces by 2.
templates.maintenance: Calibrate gyros after every hard landing, collision, or major cargo change.
templates.restrictions: A failed calibration check by 5 or more imposes -4 on control checks until repaired.

templates.label: Hybrid Boiler-Aether Core
templates.slotUse: one major engineering bay and fuel bunker
templates.activation: Continuous powered lift system using fuel and an aether regulator.
effects: Provide lift for a vessel up to the designed tonnage using common fuel and replaceable aether components.
Allow engineers to substitute Craft (mechanical) for Spellcraft on routine core maintenance.
Once per day reroute power to propulsion, weapons, or defenses for +2 on related checks for 5 rounds while imposing -2 on the other two systems.
templates.maintenance: Clean boilers daily, inspect pressure valves every voyage, and recalibrate aether flow weekly.
templates.restrictions: Consumes 25 percent more fuel than a specialized core and produces a visible exhaust signature.

templates.label: Salvaged Unknown Core
templates.slotUse: one improvised core bay
templates.primarySkill: Craft (mechanical), Craft (shipwright), or Use Magic Device
templates.activation: Uncertain; requires a successful DC 20 operation check after every shutdown.
effects: Provide lift for a vessel up to the tested tonnage and roll one additional beneficial improvement during generation.
Produce an unusual secondary output such as heat, light, communication pulses, or low-grade shielding.
Function without one ordinary fuel or environmental requirement, but acquire one additional major flaw.
templates.maintenance: Diagnose behavior after every voyage and maintain a written failure log.
templates.restrictions: Always generated with at least one major flaw, legal complication, or unknown operating condition.
